name: Orbs 🥚
desc:
Collect orbs, unlock new areas, and unlock cool orbitals as you progress through the different areas!

🔮 Collect glowing orbs across different areas
👁️ Find many secrets across the map for unique rewards
🚪 Unlock new areas by rebirthing and prestiging
📊 Upgrade spawn speed, pulling strength, and more
🛰️ Buy orbitals that fly around and collect orbs for you
🏆 Climb global leaderboards and get in-game titles
♾️ Rebirth and prestige for permanent boosts

We add events and new stuff almost every holiday!

Frequent updates, feedback is always welcome!
